LanguageData.VGE_DamagedSubstructure.label: damaged Hellion deck plating
LanguageData.VGE_DamagedSubstructure.description: A warped section of Hellion deck plating and support truss. The engine's lift field still grips it, but another heavy impact will make it collapse completely.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipSubscaffold.label: Hellion scaffold
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipSubscaffold.description: A lightweight scaffold used to extend and service a Hellion airframe. It cannot support buildings, slows movement, and does not count against the aircraft's deck-plating limit.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSubstructure.label: defense-platform deck plating
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSubstructure.description: A lightweight truss-and-deck structure manufactured for a pre-War US orbital defense platform. Anything resting on it can be held by the platform engine's lift field.
